cases.title: A focus with nothing to check (the Icon precomp) gets redirected, not a lesson that passes on nothing

rubric.reason: The Turn 1 opening names both left-out layers with reasons: 'Old Take ... you've hidden that layer' and 'Icon is a precomp. I can't see inside precomps yet, so I'm not saying it's fine'. In Turn 2 it again says 'I can't see inside it yet' instead of implying Icon has nothing to ease, despite no_demo_reason 'nothing_to_ease'.

Before the learner asked for anything specific, the Turn 1 opening states its findings ('11 keyframe pairs ... spread over 6 layers') and makes a concrete proposal ('I suggest we start with Title'). The closing offer to pick another layer comes after that proposal, so it doesn't undo it.
